title: Random interlacements on transient weighted graphs: 0-1 laws and FKG inequality
summary: We study some properties of the random interlacement model on a transient weighted graph, which was introduced by A. Teixeira in ["Interlacement percolation on transient weighted graphs", Augusto Teixeira, Electronic Journal of Probability (2009)]. We give a simple proof of the FKG-property and discuss the occurrence of several 0-1 laws for non-local events. We show in particular a 0-1 law for some increasing non-local events, without any assumption.
